workflow.name: 🛰️ BP AI Space — Data API
workflow.description: Read-only JSON API for the BP AI Command Space front-end hosted on Vercel. Returns agents, tasks, deals, KPIs, growth campaigns and integration readiness as one JSON payload. No writes, no AI calls, no external sends.
